title: Privacy Policy
acceptance: By accessing or using this website, you acknowledge that you have read and accepted this Privacy Policy and the terms described below. If you do not agree with these terms, please leave the website and discontinue its use.
collection: This website may collect information that you voluntarily provide, including your name, email address, and any information you submit through forms or other features. In addition, technical information such as your IP address, browser, operating system, device type, and anonymous usage statistics may be collected automatically.
usage: The information collected is used to maintain the website, improve its functionality, analyze usage, enhance the user experience, detect abuse, and develop new features. Your information is not sold for advertising or marketing purposes.
storage: All personal data is securely stored on servers located within the European Union (EU). Appropriate technical and organizational measures are implemented to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, or loss. While every reasonable effort is made to ensure security, no online service can guarantee absolute protection.
sharing: In certain circumstances, your information may be shared with trusted third parties when reasonably necessary to operate the website, provide infrastructure or analytics services, comply with legal obligations, or protect the rights and security of the website and its users.
cookies: This website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve performance, remember user preferences, and collect anonymous analytics. You may disable cookies in your browser settings, although doing so may affect certain features of the website.
accounts: The website provides the ability to create a user account. Registration does not guarantee access to all features of the website. Certain functionality, including but not limited to publishing content, creating public materials, or accessing restricted areas, may require additional approval, verification, invitation, or may remain unavailable at the sole discretion of the website administrator.
termination: The website owner reserves the right to suspend, restrict, or terminate access to any account or feature at any time, with or without prior notice, where permitted by applicable law.
jurisdiction: Any disputes, claims, or legal proceedings arising from the use of this website or this Privacy Policy shall be governed by the laws of Ukraine and resolved exclusively by the competent courts of Ukraine.

changes: This Privacy Policy may be updated at any time. The latest version will always be available on this page, and continued use of the website after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
